reason.why: The core value is live market data streaming and real order execution on an exchange. That is an external real-time connection, not stateful records an agent reads and changes through an API. What would make it feasible: Ask for a brokerage order-management API that keeps orders, fills, positions, watchlists and stored quote snapshots as records. Agents would place, amend, cancel and review simulated orders against seeded prices, with no live feed and no real exchange.
